# Yash Khare

> Senior AI Software Engineer based in Berlin, Germany — shipping production-ready AI products with solid foundations, from RAG pipelines and LLM integrations to full-stack platforms.

Yash Khare is a Senior AI Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience building and shipping AI-powered products end-to-end. He works at the intersection of AI engineering and scalable product development, turning LLM/ML capabilities into reliable product features. He has co-founded an AI startup, led remote teams across time zones, and generated six-figure revenues within months of launch.

Currently based in Berlin, Yash holds a Master's in Management (Innovation & High Tech) from ESCP Europe Business School (GMAT 730, 96th percentile). He combines deep technical execution with business acumen and ships fast without gambling with quality.

## Experience

- [COSMO CONSULT — AI Software Engineer](https://yashkhare0.github.io): Current role (Apr 2025 – Present), Berlin. Developed, shipped, and maintains 8 products end-to-end in 8 months with avg time-to-deployment under 3 weeks. Architected Sonar (company's most important internal AI platform) for live transcript ingestion and custom analysis. Built Translate, COSMO's highest adopted internal platform of 2025, reaching 25% usage without any marketing. Tech: Next.js, Vercel, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, PGVector, Django, Neo4j, Azure, RabbitMQ, Pulumi, PostHog, WorkOS.
- [GEM AI — Co-Founder & AI Engineer](https://yashkhare0.github.io): Paris, France (Jan 2024 – Jan 2025). Built Echo, an enterprise-grade RAG tool generating EUR 125,000 in licensing revenue in the first month. Scaled to a team of 10 developers and EUR 175,000+ revenue in 6 months. Built Snap-and-Solve (multi-LLM solver) in 25 days. Tech: Python, Django, FastAPI, ReactJS, TypeScript, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, GitHub Actions.
- [Pernod Ricard — UX Researcher](https://yashkhare0.github.io): Paris, France (Jul – Dec 2023). Automated data reporting with Python and Google Apps Script, reducing manual effort by 40%. Conducted qualitative user research and presented insights via PowerBI.
- [Passionoid Technologies & Bliip Studios — Co-Founder & Software Engineer](https://yashkhare0.github.io): Pune, India (May 2019 – Sept 2022). Led a team of 5 developers delivering 16+ projects for national and international clients. Tech: ReactJS, Flutter, Django, React Native, PostgreSQL.

## Projects

- [noll.to](https://noll.to): Privacy-first document translation SaaS. Focused on layout retention, controlled data handling, and reliable document processing. Featured project.
- [testkizuna.com](https://testkizuna.com): AI-assisted QA and testing product focused on turning quality checks into repeatable, automatable workflows.
- [Sonar AI Platform](https://sonar.apx.team): Company's most important internal AI platform. End-to-end workflow for live transcript ingestion and custom analysis. Built with FastAPI, PostgreSQL, PGVector, Azure, RabbitMQ.
- [Cosma](https://cosma.app): AI-powered business assistant that helps teams manage workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and surface insights from company data.
- [Radar](https://radar.apx.team): Internal intelligence tool for monitoring and analyzing market signals, competitive landscape, and industry trends.
- [Translate](https://translate.apx.team): COSMO's highest adopted internal platform of 2025, reaching 25% usage without any marketing. Built with Next.js, FastAPI, Azure.
- [Voko — CLI for i18n](https://yashkhare0.github.io/voko/): Interactive CLI tool for managing internationalization in JavaScript and TypeScript projects. Open source, published on npm. Supports Google Translate, DeepL, LibreTranslate, and Yandex.
- [Voko — GitHub Repository](https://github.com/yashkhare0/voko): Source code for Voko, the i18n CLI tool.
